blocks.text: WASHINGTON — The United States has “kicked out” two members of the Iranian delegation who attended the recent UN General Assembly after they ignored an order to leave the country, the State Department said Saturday. “Two more members of the Iranian delegation were found still in (New York) long after the United Nations General Assembly had passed. They have now been kicked out of the US,” a US official told AFP, adding that Secretary of State Marco Rubio “means business.” US media reported the State Department had told Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his delegation to leave the country Monday, […]...
